description: This header file defines function prototypes and interface structures related to the 'BREE' runtime execution engine components, specifically for creating, removing, and initializing BreeSpoReader components.

methods.name: CreateBreeSpoReaderComponent
methods.description: Factory function to create a BreeSpoReader component with specified container, owner, and reserved contexts.

methods.name: BreeSpoReaderCOCreate
methods.description: Creates an instance of the BreeSpoReader component with provided contexts.

methods.name: BreeSpoReaderCORemove
methods.description: Removes and cleans up the BreeSpoReader component instance.
